prompts.interior-walls: Colony2D modular wall SPRITE ATLAS. Match reference autumn palette and crisp detailed pixel clusters. STRICT ORTHOGONAL X/Y grid: X horizontal screen, Y vertical screen, zero camera yaw. No isometric/diamond perspective, no diagonally receding edges. Thick top-down wall footprints with modest south-facing front surface shading. All runs horizontal or vertical, corners literal 90-degree L, junctions T or +. True transparent background alpha=0, no haze/no background texture. Exactly8 columns8rows,64 equal padded cells, one piece per cell; consistent wall thickness and pixel density, no text. Each material uses TWO ROWS with all16 N/E/S/W masks, N=up E=right S=down W=left. Order: isolated, N, E, NE, S, NS, ES, NES; W, NW, EW, NEW, SW, NSW, ESW, NESW. All connected arms stay aligned with cell midpoint; do not rotate their grid axes. First two rows warm timber plank partitions; next two rows cream lime plaster with restrained timber supports; next two rows cool dressed limestone interior walls; final two rows muted rust brick interior walls. Clean INTACT plain structural wall pieces, no attached furniture or lamps. Smooth interior faces, square caps.
